test_title: PYST 07: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The management gave __kudos __to Jithin for his performance.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. praise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"kudos"** means praise and honor received for an achievement. (प्रशंसा)

 
 
• **Example: **She received kudos from her colleagues for her outstanding presentation.
 
 
 
• **"Praise"** refers to the expression of approval or admiration for someone or something. (प्रशंसा)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher gave praise to the student for his hard work and dedication.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"kudos"** is **"praise"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. praise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Criticism **(आलोचना): The expression of disapproval of someone or something based on perceived faults or mistakes.

 
 
• **Example:** The movie received a lot of criticism for its weak plot.
 
 
 
• **Punishment **(सजा): The infliction or imposition of a penalty as retribution for an offense.
 
 
• **Example: **He received punishment for breaking the rules.
 
 
 
• **Admonishment** (डांटना): To reprove or scold someone gently.
 
 
• **Example:** She received an admonishment from her boss for being late.
